effects.rationale: Hook trigger (frame 0): a 0.4s shadow-band lift thickens the cold-open image so the first readable frame lands harder. Low-motion conversation frame, so the accent is subtle tonal work — no glitch, aberration or blur near a face.
Chapter change at 2.0s (hook into Part One, whipPan): 0.5s of edge darkening re-centres the eye after the whip. Intensity 0.5 — the softest hit of phase 1 so hits can escalate across phases.
Chapter change at 15.0s into Part Two (lightLeak transition): a 0.5s cool shift of -9% marks the tonal turn of the conversation without breaking the single coherent grade.
Punchline accent at 21.5s — the sharpest point of the middle argument (segment 8, 0.3s in). 0.4s of 18% grain adds bite; texture only, so it never smears a face.
Pre-chapter tension over 29.6-30.0s: contrast tightens by 1.14x in the half-second before the sliceSlide into Part Three, so the phase change reads as a decision rather than a jump.
Impact at 30.0s paired with the whip-shake and the sliceSlide chapter change: 0.35s at intensity 0.85, the strongest hit in the edit — phase 3 treatment is measurably harder than phase 1's 0.5-0.55.
Pattern interrupt at 33.8s on the snap-zoom: a 0.3s +9% brightness pop. Phase 3 averages 1.33s per shot, so this keeps the 2-4s interrupt rhythm alive in the densest section.
Ramp peak at 37.9s, where speed bottoms out at 0.75x: a 0.5s saturation swell to 1.12x marks the emotional crest before the landing. Grade-family only, so it is safe on a face at slow motion.

Signature statement on the landing at 39.3s (declared here as the edit's single signature effect and timed in segment 19's effectSpecs): a warm film-burn sweep that opens the 5.7s hold and echoes the 15.0s lightLeak transition.

transitions.rationale: Chapter change at 2.0s — hook into Part One. A 0.3s whip matches the punch-in on segment 1 and hands momentum to the slow-push that follows.
Chapter change at 15.0s into Part Two. A warm 0.45s leak signals the tonal turn of the conversation and is answered by the light-leak signature on the landing at 39.3s.
Time jump at 25.2s — a 0.4s breath that separates the middle argument from its aftermath, and the only non-lateral transition in the edit so it reads as a real ellipsis.
Chapter change at 30.0s into Part Three. A 0.3s slice lands with the whip-shake and the 0.85 vignette hit; different type from the preceding dipToBlack so nothing repeats back to back.
Soft hand-off at 37.3s into the ramped climax — a 0.35s crossfade lets the 0.75x slow-down arrive without a hard edge, then the landing at 39.3s is a deliberate hard cut.

audioDecisions.rationale: No audio file was uploaded, so per the audio rule the bed comes from the source video itself. A 45s under-bed at 0.16 of the episode's opening passage glues 20 jump cuts together; it sits far below each segment's sync audio so the words are never masked.

One-shot cut accent on the whipPan chapter change at 2.0s. No SFX library exists in this project, so the transient is lifted from the source track at the incoming shot's own onset (src 78.0s) and reinforced — it lands exactly on the cut.
One-shot accent on the lightLeak chapter change into Part Two at 15.0s, sourced from the incoming shot's onset (src 158.4s) so the reveal has weight.
Hardest impact of the edit: sliceSlide plus whip-shake into Part Three at 30.0s. Loudest of the four accents (0.6) so the SFX escalates with the visual hits.
Landing entry at 39.3s, timed to the light-leak signature sweep — a soft 0.45 accent that opens the 5.7s hold without punching the viewer out of the final line.

captionTemplate.safeArea: 9:16 — all type held between y 0.66 and 0.76, clear of the top 10% and bottom 20% UI zones and below the face region

metadata.rationale: The analysis hands back a single 416.4s segment (video-1-seg-0, tagged b-roll, medium motion, conf 0.50) with no beat grid, no chapter list and no face/motion peaks. So the edit is authored structurally instead of reactively: a 20-shot highlight arc mined across the whole episode — two-shot cold-open hook (0-2.0s), a 15s setup with long breathable holds, a 15s middle that drops shot length to 71% of phase 1, and a 15s final act at 44% of phase-1 shot length that resolves into a 5.7s held landing (longer than any earlier shot). Three chapter changes (2.0s, 15.0s, 30.0s) carry the only rendered punctuation plus one soft hand-off into the ramp; everything else is a hard cut on a phrase boundary. Because the source is a conversation, the treatment is grade-family only — one coherent colorGrade across all 20 shots, with tonal/vignette/temperature/grain/contrast/brightness/saturation accents escalating 0.53 -> 0.62 -> 0.74 average intensity per phase, and a single light-leak signature bookending the 15.0s leak transition at the landing. No glitch, no aberration, no blur anywhere near a face. Cuts never fall below 0.8s and the landing holds 5.7s so no line is chopped mid-sentence.
